analogy.rationale: MTNR1A/MTNR1B are G protein-coupled receptors with very low expression in most of these cell lines, so a melatonin receptor antagonist should elicit little to no transcriptional response; other GPCR-targeting classes that also act on receptors these cells barely express are the closest analogs by expected near-null response.
